title: A closed subspace of a Gateaux differentiability space is a Gateaux differentiability space : over 46 years of open problem solved
summary: This paper establishes for the first time the iterative and rigid theory of weak$^{*}$ slices within a non-metric framework, demonstrating that dual convex sets under the pure weak$^{*}$ topology can achieve localization, diameter control, and fine structural analysis. It fundamentally transforms the traditional understanding of the geometric properties of weak$^{*}$ topology and thereby pioneers a new direction in non-metric weak$^{*}$ slice geometry.
